notes.title: night2 is added
notes.content:
[b]Night 2 is available now [/b]
In this version,new role, new game mode is available . New additional experience of being a magician like to   defeat all kinds monsters. And it still is a third person game view which allows you inspect all directions to find possible enemies easier.  You need to be very careful when they will show up from dark, and attack you suddenly.
